description:
Gentiam Electronics is a California-based tech company. Creators and problem-solvers need the freedom to explore and we empower them to solve their most compelling problems through accessible, time-saving innovations. Our platform is a pairing of custom electronics hardware with online courses that provides accessible education and tools to many, creating a world where building electronics is as easy as designing an app.

We are looking for affiliates to expose more people to our first online course on Arduino and Robotics, focused on problem-solving through hands-on projects for a beginner audience.

We are are open to building a custom partnership that is tailored to your needs. Based on what you need, in addition to a 50% commission, we are offering:
  • A customized landing page
  • Possible discounts for your audience (commissions calculated after discounts).
  • Custom marketing materials (infographics, pdfs, and other graphic design assets)
  • Showcasing your work or content on our social media and website
  • Meetings with our leadership or engineering teams to understand your needs
  • Expanding our payment methods if needed.

Thank you for your consideration. We look forward to hearing from you.

PayPal
